title: Revised Norms for appointment of an independent third-party reviewer/ certifier for green debt security

extraction.subject: Revised Norms for appointment of an independent third-party reviewer/certifier for green debt security
extraction.summary: This circular modifies the requirements for appointing an independent third-party reviewer/certifier for green debt securities to align with those for social and sustainability bonds. It specifies the conditions under which the reviewer must operate and the forms the review may take.

obligations.notes: Reviewer must be independent of issuer and have expertise in ESG debt securities.
obligations.action: Appoint an independent third-party reviewer/certifier to ascertain compliance with the definition of green debt securities and review/certify processes.
obligations.section_reference: Regulation 2(1)(q) of the SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) Regulations, 2021

obligations.action: Ensure the scope of the review by the independent third-party reviewer is specified in the offer document.

amendments_to.specific_provisions: Chapter IX, Paragraph 1.8 deleted and new Paragraph 5 inserted

extraction.risk_rationale: The changes require issuers to engage independent reviewers, which may involve additional compliance costs and processes.

obligations.notes: The appeal will be treated as withdrawn for the specified period from 1st July 2017 to 31st March 2020 or part thereof.
obligations.action: Inform the appellate authority if the taxpayer wishes to pursue the appeal only for the non-specified period.

extraction.risk_rationale: The changes affect the appeal process and refund claims, which could impact financial planning and compliance strategies for taxpayers.

title: Circular on Cyber Incident or Crisis Preparedness

It mandates timely reporting of cyber incidents, maintenance of ICT logs, synchronization of system clocks, and adherence to CERT-In guidelines. The circular emphasizes the importance of having a Cyber Crisis Management Plan and ensuring no conflict of interest in forensic investigations.

obligations.action: Maintain and monitor all ICT infrastructure and application logs.
obligations.deadline: for a rolling period of 180 days

obligations.notes: NTP Servers of NIC or NPL or traceable to these NTP Servers.
obligations.action: Synchronize clocks of all relevant information processing systems with NTP Servers.

obligations.notes: Part of organization's response for cyber-attacks.
obligations.action: Implement a Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP).

obligations.notes: Engagement of certified and competent external forensic experts as required.

title: Review of revision in  premium rates under health insurance policies for senior citizens

extraction.subject: Review of revision in premium rates under health insurance policies for senior citizens
extraction.summary: The IRDAI has issued directives to regulate the increase in premium rates for health insurance policies for senior citizens. Insurers are restricted from increasing premiums by more than 10% per annum and must consult IRDAI for higher increases or product withdrawals. This aims to protect senior citizens from steep premium hikes.

applies_to.entity_type: All Non-Life and Stand-Alone Health Insurers

obligations.action: Insurers shall not revise the premium for senior citizens by more than 10% per annum.
obligations.section_reference: Section 14 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 read with Section 34 of the Insurance Act, 1938

obligations.action: Insurers shall undertake prior consultation with the IRDAI if the increase proposed in the premium for senior citizens is more than 10% per annum.
Insurers shall undertake prior consultation with the IRDAI in case of withdrawal of individual health insurance products offered to senior citizens.
Insurers shall give wide publicity of the various measures taken for the benefit of senior citizens while offering health insurance products.
Insurers shall take necessary steps for common empanelment of hospitals and negotiate package rates on the lines of PMJAY scheme.

extraction.risk_rationale: The circular imposes new restrictions on premium increases, which may require insurers to adjust their pricing strategies and could impact their financial planning.
